items.title: Make inner folder entrypoints able to require common chunks
items.body:
Hi :wave:,
I'm not sure whether it's a good solution to the problem I faced, but I figured better try to come up with something than just open an issue, so sorry if I'm entirely not in the right direction. 


### Problem
If I have a node project with the following dir structure, where each `spec.ts` will be an
entry point.

```
.
|____inner-folder
| |____bundle-tests2.spec.ts
|____bundle-tests.spec.ts
```


I'd like to bundle it and keep the same dir structure.
After bundling it with `webpack@5.0.0-beta.9`, the result is the following dir structure:

```
.
|____inner-folder
| |____bundle-tests2.spec.js
|____commons-7f2bf9fd.js
|____bundle-tests.spec.js

```

However, in runtime, `bundle-tests2.spec.js` is failing to run, because the require path in
`RequireChunkLoadingRuntimeModule` is assumed to be the same dir, however it's not always the case.


```
    Cannot find module './commons-7f2bf9fd.js' from 'bundle-tests2.spec.js'

      129 | /******/ 			if(!installedChunks[chunkId]) {
      130 | /******/ 				if(true) { // all chunks have JS
    > 131 | /******/ 					var chunk = require("./" + __webpack_require__.u(chunkId));
          |          					            ^
      132 | /******/ 					var moreModules = chunk.modules, chunkIds = chunk.ids, runtime = chunk.runtime;
      133 | /******/ 					for(var moduleId in moreModules) {
      134 | /******/ 						if(__webpack_require__.o(moreModules, moduleId)) {

      at Resolver.resolveModule (../../../../opt/nodejs/node_modules/jest-resolve/build/index.js:259:17)
      at Object.<anonymous>.module.exports.__webpack_require__.f.require (inner-folder/bundle-tests2.spec.js:131:27)
      at Promise.all.Object.keys.reduce (inner-folder/bundle-tests2.spec.js:73:40)
          at Array.reduce (<anonymous>)
      at Function.Object.<anonymous>.module.exports.__webpack_require__.e [as e] (inner-folder/bundle-tests2.spec.js:72:67)
```

bugfix

no
